en.headline: SFC clears first secondary trading of tokenised public funds
en.dek: Two ChinaAMC tokenised money market funds began around-the-clock secondary trading on a licensed virtual asset platform on Monday, in a first for public funds.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world’s first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform, with trading of two existing authorised funds starting on Monday.

Secondary trading of the ChinaAMC HKD Digital Money Market Fund and the ChinaAMC USD Digital Money Market Fund began on an around-the-clock basis. The arrangement follows a regulatory framework the SFC introduced in April to pilot such trading.

Elisa Ng, the SFC’s Executive Director of Investment Products, said the step marks an important milestone in advancing Hong Kong’s digital asset development and adds 24/7 trading capability to the city’s tokenisation ecosystem. The regulator said it would monitor trading closely and consider expanding the product range over time.

zh.headline: 證監會批准首批代幣化基金二級市場交易
zh.dek: 兩隻華夏基金代幣化貨幣市場基金周一起於持牌虛擬資產平台提供全日制二級市場交易，屬公募基金首次。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會批准全球首次於持牌虛擬資產交易平台進行代幣化公募基金的二級市場交易，兩隻現有認可基金的交易於周一開始。
華夏基金港元數字貨幣市場基金及華夏基金美元數字貨幣市場基金開始提供全日制二級市場交易。是次安排建基於證監會今年4月推出的監管框架。
證監會投資產品部執行董事吳蕙蘭表示，此舉標誌證監會推進香港數字資產發展的重要里程碑，並為本港代幣化生態系統增添24小時交易能力。監管機構表示將密切監察交易活動，並會按市場發展考慮擴大產品範圍。
